resources.string: Deeper cache cleanup
Optional Shizuku access lets Android trim app caches across the phone. It does not unlock every private file or system folder.
Install and start Shizuku to enable deeper cache cleanup.
Start Shizuku, then return here. It may need restarting after a phone reboot.
Shizuku is running. Allow SqueakySift to use it.
Shizuku access is ready.
Waiting for Android to trim app caches…
Allow Shizuku access
Set up Shizuku
Trim all app caches
Trim caches across all apps?

Android will decide which app caches to remove from internal storage, including private caches it manages. This request applies across all apps and cannot honor individual app exclusions. Apps may need to download cached content again. Saved accounts and app data are not the target of this operation.
Android finished processing the cache-trim request. It does not report whether every cache was removed.
Available storage increased by %1$s during the request. Other phone activity can also affect this value.
No increase in available storage was measured. Android may have retained caches or other phone activity may have used space.
Shizuku access was not allowed. You can still scan and remove shared files.
Allow SqueakySift in Shizuku’s Authorized applications screen, then return here.
Update Shizuku to version 13 or newer, start it, then return here.
Shizuku could not start the cache request. Check that it is running and SqueakySift is authorized.
Android did not confirm completion of the cache request. Some caches may already have been trimmed.
The cache request timed out. Android may still finish work already requested; its result is unknown.
The Shizuku connection stopped. Android may still finish work already requested; its result is unknown.
No Shizuku access decision was received. Check its Authorized applications screen, then try again.
